scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplied for every universal statement; exact rational and Monte Carlo checks supplement rather than replace it; independently reviewed science not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Strict convex quadrilaterals; independent uniform point on each of four different sides; full law given only for parallelograms; no claim for iid unstratified boundary samples or higher polygons. Residual unindexed-equivalence risk.
title: Universal mean, sharp variance, and logarithmic law for side-sampled quadrilaterals
